summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) to furnish its Fourth Amended and Restated Articles of Association, adopted by special resolution at a general meeting on June 12, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance update — amending the company's constitutional documents — not a special situation event. The filing contains no transaction, no change of control, no capital return, and no activist involvement. It is a standard administrative filing with no structural or market-impacting terms. Thus, this filing does not trigger any special-situations classification.
